resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Simplified Chinese source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review checks, typecheck, complete build, route and generated-link checks, and the full test suite passed after the cycle was finalized.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Simplified Chinese pass identified six remaining formula-notation and unit-translation defects; all six were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Simplified Chinese human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted for this cycle.

findings.summary: The tangent formula used an inconsistent Chinese term for the adjacent side and omitted spacing around the division.
evidence: The previous expression was tan(θ) = 对边/相邻 while the explanation used 邻边.
findings.resolution: Changed it to tan(θ) = 对边 / 邻边.

findings.summary: The inverse-trigonometry formulas used full-width punctuation and inconsistent spacing.
evidence: The previous formulas mixed full-width parentheses with compact slash notation.
findings.resolution: Normalized all three inverse formulas to consistent notation and spacing.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff voltage-law formula omitted the spacing in the protected sigma expression.
evidence: The previous expression was ΣV = 0 rather than the canonical Σ V = 0.

findings.summary: The voltage-law annotation retained the English phrase parallel branches.
evidence: The previous formula ended with (parallel branches) in an otherwise Simplified Chinese section.

findings.summary: The cell formulas retained the English series and parallel annotations.
evidence: The previous expressions ended with (series) and (parallel).
findings.resolution: Changed them to (串联) and (并联).

findings.summary: The imperial length-conversion formulas retained English unit names in the Simplified Chinese section.
evidence: The formulas used inch, foot, feet, yard, and in² while the worked example used Chinese names.
findings.resolution: Localized the four displayed length conversions as 英寸, 英尺, 码, and 英寸².
